title: Training Note: Service-Recovery Share for Established Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Tenants
content:
*Tenant care training — billing corrections on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.*

**The rule.** When a billing-error correction credit is worked out, the service-recovery share is 5% for a tenant who has held the agreement at least 36 months and made at least 10 payments on it in the last 12 months; it is 3.5% for a tenant who has held it at least 12 months but fewer than 36 months and made at least 6 payments on it in the last 12 months. For every other tenant this rule makes no adjustment to the share.

Tenure is counted in whole calendar months from the agreement's start date to the handling date, to the same day of the later month (or that month's last day when the day does not exist). A window of the last 12 months covers entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month. Payments are the payment entries on the agreement's ledger dated inside that window.

**Questions and answers.**

*Q. A tenant has held the space 40 months and made 11 payments in the window. What share applies?* 5%: both parts of the long-standing condition hold.

*Q. The same tenant made only 9 payments in the window.* The 5% condition fails on payments, and the 3.5% condition is limited to tenants under 36 months, so this rule makes no adjustment.

*Q. A tenant at exactly 12 months with exactly 6 payments?* 3.5%: both thresholds are met at equality.

*Q. A tenant at 11 months with 12 payments?* Below 12 months, so neither condition holds and this rule makes no adjustment.

| Months held | Payments in last 12 months | Share under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | 10 or more | 5% |
| 36 or more | 9 or fewer | no adjustment |
| 12 to 35 | 6 or more | 3.5% |
| 12 to 35 | 5 or fewer | no adjustment |
| under 12 | any | no adjustment |
